payload.summary: Refined the roadmap scaffold for sandboxed-flow ri-02 into a full plan: a machine-readable audit table of vendor terms and credential mechanics with an evidence level per field, a guide, a metadata-only observation script, and corrections to two existing documents.
completed_work: proposal.md, design.md, tasks.md, spec delta under vendor-auth-audit, contracts stub, work-packages.yaml
Discovery questions and both approval gates not asked: item pre-approved in the roadmap and dispatched by autopilot-roadmap

decisions.title: The YAML audit table is the source and the guide explains it
decisions.rationale: ri-03 reads one file; tests can hold verdicts to a quote and source.

decisions.title: Each mechanics field carries an evidence level
decisions.rationale: The container cannot run three of the four CLIs, so documented and observed facts must stay distinguishable.

decisions.title: Unattended lanes without a permitted verdict require an API-key or gateway-key lane
decisions.rationale: An unaddressed lane is not treated as permission.

decisions.title: The observation script reports metadata only
decisions.rationale: It must never read credential content.
